sn35.71:1.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañ ca atthagamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti || avusitaṃ tena brahmacariyaṃ ārakā so imasmā dhammavinayā ti || ||
sn35.71:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Etthāham bhante anassāsiṃ || ahañhi bhante channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañ ca atthagamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti || ||
sn35.71:3.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi bhikkhu || || Cakkhum etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassassī ti || ||
sn35.71:5.1: Sādhu bhikkhu ettha ca te bhikkhu Cakkhu netaṃ mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭham bhavissati || esevanto dukkhassa || la || || Jivhā etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassasi || ||
sn35.71:7.1: Sādhu bhikkhu ettha ca te bhikkhu Jivhā netam mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati || esevanto dukkhassa || la || || Manam- -esevanto
